text:
This sea is a clustered sea

in two arms of land, clamorous

with sirocco and southwest wind...; it is a thick

old wine of salts and iodine.


It is a sea for intact young people;

and it is a sea for beings who already know

what the sea carries in itself, from the land.

It is a sea without riders, it does not gallop.


And this smell of millennia smelled by

its shores of pines and palms

is of the sea upon the sea: it is already celestial

like the hands of lingering archangels.


Oh its light and its sound, its great clouds

that the east wind detaches from the skies

and overturns into the field, like rivers

returning from God, the bronze sea!




The Poems of Mar Menor, 1959

translation.title: This Sea Is a Clustered Sea...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the Mar Menor as clustered bronze sea of salts, winds, and celestial shore-smell.
